inputContract.instructions: Play Snake. Maximize food eaten before the episode ends. Avoid walls and your body. Coordinates are [x,y], origin at top left; x increases right and y increases down. Body is head first. Heading is 0=up, 1=right, 2=down, 3=left. Choose a turn relative to the current heading. The snake moves one cell every 250 milliseconds while you decide. Your turn is applied once at the next tick strictly after it arrives, relative to the heading at that time. While waiting, the snake continues straight. At most one request is outstanding. The tail vacates unless food is eaten. Starvation and the step limit end the episode. Return one action: left, straight, or right.

criteria.left: Turn 90 degrees left, then move one cell.
criteria.straight: Keep the current heading and move one cell.
criteria.right: Turn 90 degrees right, then move one cell.
